purpose: Teach: うみ/はく/キモ/フッ/遊ば/握ら/イーグル/窯

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 海辺、うみねこの声、よく聞こえたな、昔の夏。
lines.en: The seaside, the cries of seagulls — you could hear them so clearly back then, in those old summers.
lines.style: Quiet, distant opening. Pause after the first phrase, letting memory settle in. Slow, unhurried pace. Voice trails into the past. Gentle, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。ゆっくり息をはくのが、ヨガの基本、毎朝続けてるのよ。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. Slow exhales — that's the foundation of yoga. I've been keeping it up every morning.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Not performing wisdom, just sharing habit. Slightly brighter on the second sentence — a small pride in consistency. Breath held quietly under the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔は、新鮮なキモ、よく食べたな、田舎では。
lines.en: Back then, we ate fresh liver all the time out in the countryside.
lines.style: Soft opening. Eyes distant. Simple declarative tone, as if surprised the memory is still there. Pause before the final phrase. No judgment — just fact, held gently.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 歯科で、フッ素塗布、勧められたわよ、私も、最近。
lines.en: My dentist recommended fluoride treatment recently too.
lines.style: Practical, conversational. A small nod of relatability — she's tracked with his thought even though it shifted. Light, unhurried. Warm eye contact underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫を、もっと遊ばせてあげたいな、休みの時。
lines.en: I wish I could let the grandkids play more during time off.
lines.style: Soft, almost apologetic opening. The word 'wish' carries a small ache. Quiet, reflective middle. Slight fadeout at the end — not quite finished thinking, but leaving room for her response.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 手、ぎゅっと握らないで、優しく、頂戴ね、あなた。
lines.en: Don't grip my hand so tightly, dear. Gently — please.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not sharp. A small squeeze of affection underneath the request. Slow, warm pace. The word 'dear' is intimate and particular — meant for him alone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ゴルフで、イーグル、夢で終わったな、私。
lines.en: When I was young, I dreamed of getting an eagle in golf. Never quite happened, though.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, almost amused at the old ambition. Light, wry touch on 'dreamed.' The voice lifts slightly on the regret — it's funny now, not bitter. Shrug in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 陶芸の窯、教室でも、見学できるそうよ、面白そう。
lines.en: Apparently you can tour the pottery kiln at the workshop. That sounds interesting, doesn't it?
lines.style: Brightening energy, genuine curiosity in the voice. Slight uptick on 'interesting' — inviting him to see it with her. Forward-leaning, engaged. The close suggests a shared future.
